v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Events can only be scheduled for 09:00 to 17:00, excluding 12:00-13:00.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Events cannot be scheduled to overlap with other events.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Valid start times must be returned in ascending order.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Events on other days shall not affect the day being scheduled.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: An event lasting more than 8 hours (480 minutes) should fail.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_6: The possible start times should be returned in increments of its duration, not every possible minute.

v1_human_g3_exception: Holidays should not be scheduled. Saturdays and Sundays should not be scheduled. Non-peaceable events should be ignored.

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: The system shall schedule a new event between 09:00 and 17:00 on a given day.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: The system shall not schedule a new event to overlap with currently-scheduled events.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: The system shall return a list of possible start times to schedule a new event, sorted in increasing order.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: The system shall return an empty list if the new event cannot be validly scheduled.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_5: The system shall not schedule events during 12:00-13:00 (lunch break).
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_6: The system shall return valid start times in increments of the event duration, not every possible minute.

v1_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to schedule a new event given that multiple events are already scheduled. The newly scheduled event should not conflict with other scheduled events or be scheduled outside working hours.
v1_human_g3_input: Events: list of events that are already scheduled. Each event has a start and end time. meeting_duration: the length of time the new event needs. day: the day that is being scheduled.

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: The events list must not be modified.
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_2: There must never be overlapping events unless they were already scheduled by the user.
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_3: There must never be events v1_human 09:00, when 12:00-13:00, or v2_human 17:00, unless they were already scheduled by the user.

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: The system must never schedule an event v1_human 09:00, between 12:00-13:00 or v2_human 17:00.
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: The system must not never schedule an event that overlaps with currently-scheduled events.

v1_human_g3_output: a list of valid start times where the new event could be scheduled. Could be empty, OR a valid start time(s).
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: If two start times can be valid start times to the event and they are within the meeting duration, the earlier event should be suggested only.
